literal_meaning: ছেলেদের চরানো (বাছুর বা পশু চরানোর মতো)
figurative_meaning_en: Teaching or tutoring in a sarcastic or belittling manner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছেলে চরানো করে জীবিকা নির্বাহ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: I make a living by grazing boys (teaching kids).
He earns his keep by herding boys (tutoring sarcastically).
note: Idiom implies menial teaching job, rooted in rural pastoral imagery
